name: prism
description: EXPERIMENTAL, OPT-IN: give every project in the ZCode desktop sidebar its own color, icon and display name, recolor individual conversations and automation cards, and keep the sidebar ordered by the most recently active conversation. Nothing is modified until you create the opt-in marker (~/.zcode/prism-opt-in); a SessionStart hook then installs a small renderer shim into the ZCode.app bundle (macOS), re-applies it after app updates, and automatically restores the original bundle once the marker is removed.

description_i18n.en: EXPERIMENTAL, OPT-IN: give every project in the ZCode desktop sidebar its own color, icon and display name, recolor individual conversations and automation cards, and keep the sidebar ordered by the most recently active conversation. Nothing is modified until you create the opt-in marker (~/.zcode/prism-opt-in); a SessionStart hook then installs a small renderer shim into the ZCode.app bundle (macOS), re-applies it after app updates, and automatically restores the original bundle once the marker is removed.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 实验性、需显式开启：为 ZCode 桌面端侧边栏的每个项目提供专属颜色、图标与显示名，支持单条对话与自动化卡片换色，并可让侧边栏按最近活跃自动排序。创建开启标记（~/.zcode/prism-opt-in）前不做任何修改；开启后 SessionStart 钩子向 ZCode.app 包内安装轻量渲染层 shim（仅限 macOS，应用更新后自动恢复），移除标记即自动还原原始应用包。

dimTitles.title: 压暗对话标题
dimTitles.description: 会话标题以 60% 不透明度显示；取色盘里的开关可临时覆盖此设置

brightenThinking.title: 调亮思考扫光
brightenThinking.description: 提升思考/流式动画在深色主题下的可见度；取色盘开关可临时覆盖

autoColor.title: 自动配色（未指定的项目）
autoColor.description: 未手动指定颜色的项目按路径哈希自动分配色相；默认关闭，只有手动指定的项目染色

groupRecency.title: 侧边栏按最近活跃排序
groupRecency.description: 对话按最后活跃时间排序、项目/分组按最新对话排序；纯显示层重排，不影响手动拖拽顺序
